title: ottochloa arnottiana
intro: Ottochloa arnottiana, commonly known as the New Zealand wind grass, is a species of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Ottochloa arnottiana include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds. Further research is needed to fully understand the health benefits and bioactive constituents of this plant.
